sc68 / SNDH player (Benjamin Gerard et al.), upstream https://github.com/Zeinok/sc68 (git mirror of the sc68 Subversion trunk, https://sourceforge.net/projects/sc68/), commit be34af44058bbf12e39f8401e262aa44228674ae ("Updated sndh database", 2016-12-19). Package version 3.0.0 (hand-written config/config.h). License: GPL-3.0-or-later, text in COPYING (copyright Benjamin Gerard; AUTHORS lists contributors). Used by the SNDH module only (plugins/replayers/sndh), built as a loadable library under SELECTA_GPL_PLUGINS=ON; never linked into the core binaries.
Copied: file68/src and file68/sc68 (SC68 / SNDH file reader, ICE! detection, time database), libsc68/src, libsc68/sc68, libsc68/emu68 (MC68000 emulator), libsc68/io68 (YM-2149, MFP, shifter, Paula, MW, mixer), libsc68/dial68/dial68.[ch] (dialog stub), unice68/unice68_unpack.c + unice68.h + unice68_private.h + unice68_version.c (ICE! depacker) and unice68/COPYING. Not copied: autotools files, Windows/MSVC projects, the sc68/info68/mksc68 command-line programs, GUI dialogs, the data68 player/replay-routine database, the unice68 packer, documentation, and gzip68.c and the ao / curl / zlib back ends (only the vfs68_z / vfs68_ao / vfs68_curl stub sources are kept, the features are undefined). Patched and generated as listed in PATCHES.txt.
